description: Two human head profiles overlap back to back: a smaller head faces left in front and a taller head faces right behind it, each with a stepped nose and chin. A heart sits where they overlap, above a short neck line.
Three head-and-shoulder figures stand together: a taller central figure in front, its round head raised above two smaller figures on either side whose shoulders tuck behind it.
A large circle sits on a short vertical stem crossed by a horizontal bar near its lower end, forming the upright Venus symbol.
A large circle sits on a short vertical stem crossed by a horizontal bar near its lower end, forming the upright Venus symbol.
Two equal circles interlock side by side. The left circle has a downward stem with a crossbar, and the right circle has a straight arrow pointing to the upper right.
Two equal circles interlock side by side. The left circle has a downward stem with a crossbar; the right circle has a matching crossed stem angled toward the upper right.
A circle has a plain stem pointing straight down and two arrows rising diagonally to the upper left and upper right. The upper-left arrow shaft carries a short perpendicular crossbar.
A circle has a plain stem pointing straight down and two arrows rising diagonally to the upper left and upper right. The upper-left arrow shaft carries a short perpendicular crossbar.

A girl’s head faces right in profile, with shoulder-length hair falling behind it and a curved parting line across the crown. A small ear sits at the hairline, and short lines mark the neck and shoulder.
A standing figure with a round head raises one bent arm high on the right side while the other arm hangs at its side. Two straight vertical legs stand beneath a straight-sided torso.
A round head sits above a squared torso with rounded shoulders and a flat base. A straight sash crosses the torso diagonally from the lower centre to the right shoulder.
A man’s head-and-shoulders silhouette with a defined neck rises behind a lectern. The lectern is a long horizontal top with two straight legs splaying slightly outward.
Three standing figures with round heads cluster together, the central one taller and slightly in front. A wide flat ellipse sits beneath their feet as a shared platform.
A man and a woman stand side by side as full figures. The man has a hair fringe and straight trousers; the woman has parted hair and an A-line dress with legs below.
A woman’s head-and-shoulders bust with long hair and a centre parting stands in front on the left. A man’s bust silhouette is partly hidden behind her on the right.
A man’s head-and-shoulders bust with short hair and ears stands in front on the left. A woman’s bust with hair swept to one side is partly hidden behind him on the right.
Two full standing figures with plain round heads stand side by side. The woman on the left wears an A-line dress over narrow legs; the man on the right has a straight-sided body and legs.
Two identical standing figures with round heads stand side by side, each with a squared torso, short arm stubs at the sides and a narrower leg section below.
Two plain head-and-shoulders silhouettes overlap: the front bust sits on the left and a matching bust is partly hidden behind it on the right.
Three simple user figures, each a round head over an arched shoulder line, sit in a triangle: one centred on top and two side by side below it.
Two women’s head-and-shoulders busts overlap, each with long hair framing the face. The front bust sits on the left with a pointed fringe; the second is partly hidden behind it on the right.
Two women’s heads with curved fringes and hair falling past the jaw sit above wide rounded shoulders. The front woman is on the left; the second is partly hidden behind her.
A standing figure with a round head stands at the right end of a low bed. The bed has an upright post at the left, a raised pillow and a flat mattress running up to the figure’s legs.

concept: Person Bust with Short Diagonal Strap
description: A round head sits above a squared torso with rounded shoulders and a flat base. A short diagonal stroke rises inside the lower-right corner of the torso.
A circle encloses a head-and-shoulders silhouette with a narrow neck. The shoulder lines run outward and end on the lower part of the circle, cropping the bust like a profile photo.

A wide rounded card holds a small head-and-shoulders portrait on its left and two horizontal text lines of unequal length on its right. A small semicircular notch cuts into the centre of the bottom edge.
A round-headed figure with arched shoulders stands behind a lectern: a long horizontal top with two straight legs splaying slightly outward.
A round head sits above a wide dome of shoulders that ends in a flat horizontal base, forming the basic head-and-shoulders user silhouette.

concept: Two Figures, One with Raised Arm
description: Two sturdy standing figures with round heads stand side by side with legs apart. The left figure bends one arm up over its head; the right figure rests both hands at its hips.
A man’s head and shoulders face left in profile, with a sharp nose and chin, wavy hair piled high on the crown, a dot eye and a curved ear. A neck line leads into sloping shoulders.
A round head with short hair flicks curling out at both sides sits above a trapezoid dress with a flat hem, forming a simple standing woman figure.

A head-and-shoulders user is split vertically down the middle: the left half is a plain round head and shoulder, while the right half of the head and shoulder is drawn as the toothed outline of a gear.
A small user figure stands at the centre of a ring made of curved arc segments. A square at the top, a circle at the lower left and a triangle at the lower right sit in the gaps of the ring.
Two round-headed figures stand side by side, drawn as heads over long arched bodies. A hand rests on the far shoulder of the left figure, joined by an arm reaching across from the right figure.

Two round-headed figures stand close with interlinked arms: one arm loops around from the left figure’s shoulder, and a rounded hand and forearm wrap across the right figure’s body. Short straight legs extend below.
A figure strides forward to the right, one arm bent at its chest. A teardrop-shaped bundle hangs from a stick carried over its back shoulder, with the tied knot at the top.
A person sits hunched on the right, knees drawn up and arms wrapped around them with the head bowed. An upright tapering trash can with a flat lid and small handle stands on the left.
Three women’s heads with fringes and hair falling past the jaw sit in a triangle: one centred on top and two side by side below. Each lower head sits over an arched shoulder line.
Three user figures sit in a triangle. A woman with long hair and a fringe is centred on top; two men with swept fringes sit side by side below, each over an arched shoulder line.
Three user figures sit in a triangle. A plain round head is centred on top above a short shoulder arc; two women with fringes and hair past the jaw sit side by side below.
A woman’s head and shoulders face forward, with a pointed centre-parted fringe framing an oval face and hair falling to the jaw. The neck opens into sloping shoulders that end without a base line.
A woman’s head-and-shoulders bust faces forward, with straight hair falling past the chin on both sides and a swept parting over the face. The shoulders close with a flat horizontal base.
A woman’s head-and-shoulders silhouette with long hair and a centre parting rises behind a lectern: a long horizontal top with two straight legs splaying slightly outward.
